summaryZh: Cognitive Neuroscience Lab 研究脑的信息处理与认知之间的关系，网站列出镜像神经元与自闭症、脑机接口、耳鸣和视觉追踪等方向。已有页面包含2013–2014年内容，不能视为2026年课题清单。
researchQuestions: 脑的信息处理与认知之间如何相互作用？
topics: 脑机接口、耳鸣及视觉追踪

evidence.quote: We work with information processing in the brain with the primary goal of understanding the complex interplay between brain biology and cognition
Our research involves mirror neurons and autism, brain-computer interfaces, tinnitus, gender differences during visual tracking, and more...
University of California San Diego Department of Cognitive Science
